remaining_points.note: The renderer places a four-cell graphical ornament between the right-aligned value and this editable suffix; those layout cells are not authored spaces.

max_level_next.note: Shown in the NEXT value field at maximum level. Retail constructs this at runtime rather than storing a text record.

no_magic_points.note: Shown in the current/maximum MP fields when the actor has no MP capacity. Retail constructs this at runtime rather than storing a text record, and the renderer inserts one fixed alignment cell after the slash.
